call_llm: call the LLM with a prompt and Pydantic model, returning structured output with retry logic
create_default_response: create a safe default Pydantic model response based on field types when LLM calls fail
extract_json_from_response: extract JSON data from markdown-formatted LLM response content
get_agent_model_config: get agent-specific LLM model configuration with fallback to global defaults
call_llm_with_retries: call the LLM with automatic retries and error handling for robust API usage
